parameters.query:
select (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'brief_time') as brief_time,
       (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'brief_last_sent') as last_sent

with d as (select (((now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata') as s)
select
  to_char((select s from d) at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' as cal_min,
  to_char(((select s from d) + interval '1 day') at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' as cal_max,
  (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'bark_key') as bark_key,
  (select value from jarvis.settings where key = 'home_location') as home_location,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) from (
     select id, title, remind_at from jarvis.items
     where type = 'reminder' and status = 'open' and parent_id is null
       and remind_at >= (select s from d) and remind_at < (select s from d) + interval '1 day'
     order by remind_at limit 20) r) as reminders_today,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) from (
     select id, title, remind_at from jarvis.items
     where type = 'reminder' and status = 'open' and parent_id is null and recurrence is null
       and last_notified_at is not null and remind_at < (select s from d)
     order by remind_at limit 20) r) as stale,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) from (
     select id, title, due_at from jarvis.items
     where type = 'task' and status = 'open' and parent_id is null and space <> 'college'
       and due_at is not null and due_at < (select s from d) + interval '1 day'
     order by due_at limit 12) t) as tasks_due,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) from (
     select id, title, due_at from jarvis.items
     where type = 'task' and status = 'open' and parent_id is null and space = 'college'
     order by due_at nulls last, created_at limit 80) t) as college_tasks,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) from (
     select id, title, due_at from jarvis.items
     where type = 'date' and status = 'open' and due_at >= (select s from d) and due_at < (select s from d) + interval '8 days'
     order by due_at limit 12) x) as dates_soon,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(h), '[]'::json) from (
     select i.id, i.title,
            (select coalesce(json_agg(to_char(l.log_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by l.log_date), '[]'::json)
             from jarvis.habit_logs l where l.habit_id = i.id and l.done and l.log_date >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 400) as dates
     from jarvis.items i where i.type = 'habit' and i.status = 'active' order by i.created_at) h) as habits,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) from (
     select account, label, count(*)::int as n from jarvis.email_messages
     where received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' group by account, label) t) as email_counts,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(i), '[]'::json) from (
     select account, coalesce(nullif(sender_name, ''), sender_email) as sender, left(subject, 80) as subject from jarvis.email_messages
     where received_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and label = 'important' order by received_at desc limit 12) i) as email_important,
  (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'email_synced_at') as email_synced_at

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ device_key: $json.bark_key, title: $json.push.title, body: $json.push.body, level: 'active', group: 'Jarvis' }) }}

parameters.query: insert into jarvis.settings (key, value) values ('brief_last_sent', to_jsonb($1::text)) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value
